definitions.explanation: A concise reference book that organizes essential information on a subject for quick lookup. Often used for practical, technical, or educational purposes.

examples.japanese: {化学|かがく}{便覧|べんらん}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To look something up in a chemistry handbook.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{便覧|べんらん}に{履修|りしゅう}{方法|ほうほう}が{載|の}っている。
examples.english: The course registration process is listed in the student handbook.

examples.japanese: この{便覧|べんらん}には{日本|にほん}の{統計|とうけい}データが{分|わ}かりやすくまとめられている。
examples.english: This reference guide compiles Japan's statistical data in an easy-to-understand format.

notes:
A compound of {便|べん} (convenient) and {覧|らん} (viewing/reading). Implies a practical, quick-reference publication rather than an in-depth textbook.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化学|かがく}{便覧|べんらん}: chemistry handbook
- {学生|がくせい}{便覧|べんらん}: student handbook
- {統計|とうけい}{便覧|べんらん}: statistical compendium
- {便覧|べんらん}を{参照|さんしょう}する: to consult a handbook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハンドブック: handbook (loanword) — more commonly used in modern everyday contexts
- マニュアル: manual — implies step-by-step instructions rather than quick reference
- {辞典|じてん}: dictionary/encyclopedia — organized alphabetically or by topic with fuller entries
- {要覧|ようらん}: summary guide — similar format but emphasizes giving an overview
